Kidde Commercial South Africa.event: rebranded to Kidde Fire & Security South Africa
Kidde Commercial South Africa.evidence: In July 2025, the company (formerly Carrier Fire & Security South Africa) officially rebranded as Kidde Fire & Security South Africa under the Kidde Global Solutions platform, following its acquisition by Lone Star Funds. The company provides fire detection and security technology solutions in South Africa according to trade news reports.
